title: Stripe Live secret key and Stripe Test secret key: one-property twin (public-prefix)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix is that of a public sibling identifier rather than the secret. Legacy mutation notes: public prefix: pk_live_ (documented as safe to expose) vs secret sk_live_ and public prefix: pk_test_ (documented as safe to expose) vs secret sk_test_. Twin of "Stripe Live secret key and Stripe Test secret key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of stripe-token-live-plain: public prefix: pk_live_ (documented as safe to expose) vs secret sk_live_. The provider documents this namespace as public, so silence is provider-evidenced.
